comparison.objective: Load, centre, and sharply focus a microscope specimen without objective contact; candidate performs manual parts/media separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Microscope versions test spring-holder operation, slide placement, stage-knob positioning, and fine focus control, not many-body sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Final versions require a correctly loaded slide, centred alignment mark, focus within 10 µm, and no <0.5 mm objective approach; candidate requires separation, retention, support, release, and dwell.
comparison.reason: All 25 versions remain optical-stage alignment tasks and are materially unrelated to screen-based separation.
